verdict.rationale: Meilisearch supports adding/indexing large document sets (community reports of importing millions of records and batch indexing working well), and its MCP integration lets an AI agent create indexes, add documents, and configure settings via natural language, implying bulk workflows. However, there's no explicit vendor documentation of a dedicated bulk API for large-scale updates/deletes, and independent reports show real limits: unpredictable RAM under heavy write/search load and indexing falling behind for hours with fast-changing datasets. missing for 10: explicit vendor-documented bulk add/update/delete API semantics, AI-driven bulk operation examples, and consistent independent confirmation of reliable bulk performance at scale.
